content: Next.js official docs (nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/testing/vitest, updated 2026-02-11, Next 16.3.0) recommend Vitest + React Testing Library for unit testing App Router apps. Vitest cannot run async Server Components as unit tests (recommend Playwright/E2E for those); sync components, client components, and plain server-side functions (services/repos/route handlers) are fully testable with Vitest.
